Engineer observability, monitoring, telemetry, logging and network-management platforms that support reliable network operations. Develop and maintain operating procedures for secure, stable and efficient platform management. Define implementation, testing, rollback and recovery approaches for significant engineering changes. Security and Compliance Translate security and compliance requirements into platform designs, technical controls and validation criteria. Apply secure-by-design practices and contribute to threat modelling for critical network services. Engineer hardening, vulnerability remediation, privileged access, secrets, keys, certificates and centralised audit logging. Support security investigations and preserve relevant operational and forensic evidence. Identify and address risks associated with unsupported, end-of-life or non-compliant components. Produce and maintain architecture documents, technical designs, implementation plans, support models, runbooks and audit evidence. Deep Linux troubleshooting, performance, lifecycle and platform design capability. Strong DNS expertise, including design, delegation, resolution, resilience, security, troubleshooting and operational governance. Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, routing principles, BGP, network segmentation, firewalls and load balancing. Strong understanding of NTP, PKI, TLS, certificate lifecycle, authentication protocols, identity management and LDAP. Strong automation capability using Ansible, Bash or Python and infrastructure-as-code principles. Experience designing and validating high-availability, backup, restoration, continuity and disaster-recovery solutions. Deep understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001 and CIS benchmarks. Experience leading complex technical incidents, root-cause analysis and cross-functional engineering delivery. Excellent communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable Skills And Knowledge Advanced knowledge in one or more of routing infrastructure, AAA, identity, network observability or network monitoring. Virtualisation platforms such as VMware and KVM. Containerisation technologies such as Docker or Podman and awareness of Kubernetes operational workflows. Enterprise storage technologies such as SAN and NAS. Oracle databases and their integration with Linux. Windows Server environments. On-premises and cloud environments including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. Leadership and Behaviours Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for high-quality technical and service outcomes. Technical leadership: guides engineering activity and decisions without formal line management. Outcome-driven: focuses on measurable, reliable, resilient and secure results. Strategic thinking: aligns technical decisions with broader network and business strategy. Communication: presents complex technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration: builds strong working relationships across network engineering, architecture, security, infrastructure and operations. Adaptability and continuous improvement: responds effectively to operational change and identifies opportunities for optimisation and innovation. Preferred Qualifications / Education And Experience Degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience. Typically seven or more years of relevant Linux or infrastructure engineering experience. Certifications such as RHCE, LFCS, LFCE or relevant network or security credentials are beneficial. Summary Senior technical authority role focused on the design, delivery, lifecycle, resilience, security and operational excellence of Linux-based platforms supporting critical telecommunications network services.
